bubble_bunny_pink.description: A pink speech bubble with a bunny decoration.
bubble_bunny_pink.name: Pink Bunny Bubble

bubble_butter_chick.description: A butter-yellow speech bubble with a chick decoration.
bubble_butter_chick.name: Butter Chick Bubble

bubble_starry_cat.description: A deep violet speech bubble with a starry cat decoration.
bubble_starry_cat.name: Starry Cat Bubble

character_chinchilla.description: Fresh from a sand bath, it came to play. Before saying hello, it has to show off that fluffy fur.

character_duck.description: An expert at ducking responsibility. It has the duck feet to prove it.

character_guinea_pig.description: It forgot where it hid its snack. Judging by those full cheeks, it can't be far away.

character_monkey.description: It came to share a banana. It says it only took one bite on the way… so why is half gone?

character_otter.description: It came to show off its favorite clam. You can look, but it will sulk if you take it.

character_pig.description: It followed the smell of snacks and decided to stay. Now it thinks this is home.

character_poop.description: Not sure who called, but here it is.

character_quokka.description: Always smiling. Yes, this is the one who just threw that leaf.

character_shiba.description: We already went for a walk. The Shiba refuses to acknowledge that fact.

character_starlight_upalupa.description: This axolotl brought home a lost star and hugs it tight even while sleeping.

character_tree.description: A little tree went out for a walk. Told to take a break, it started choosing where to put down roots.

character_tteokbokki.description: They said it was mild. They never said whose idea of mild they meant.

throwable_banana.description: The monkey shared this banana. We haven't had a chance to ask whether that was intentional.
throwable_banana.name: Monkey's Banana

throwable_baseball.description: A red-stitched ball that squashes on impact and bounces away.
throwable_baseball.name: Baseball

throwable_bouncy_heart.description: A throwable heart that bounces as it flies.
throwable_bouncy_heart.name: Bouncy Heart

throwable_clam.description: The clam the otter carried everywhere. There's no pearl inside, just some lingering attachment.
throwable_clam.name: Otter's Clam

throwable_dujjonku.description: Its cocoa shell and green filling squash with a satisfying crunch.
throwable_dujjonku.name: Dubai Chocolate Chewy Cookie

throwable_dust_bath_pouch.description: It's the chinchilla's bath sand. Throwing it probably isn't a hint that you need a wash.
throwable_dust_bath_pouch.name: Chinchilla's Sand Pouch

throwable_fish_cake_skewer.description: That was meant for eating. Why are you swinging it around?
throwable_fish_cake_skewer.name: Fish Cake Skewer

throwable_leaf.description: It's the quokka's packed lunch. We didn't ask whether it was okay to throw it.
throwable_leaf.name: Leaf

throwable_mini_paprika.description: A carefully saved snack. If you pick it up within three seconds after throwing it, that's fine, right?
throwable_mini_paprika.name: Guinea Pig's Mini Pepper

throwable_pork.description: A satisfyingly solid slap! By the way, has anyone seen the pig next door lately?
throwable_pork.name: Baby Pig's Pork

throwable_snowflake.description: A snowflake that scatters into tiny crystal shards on impact.
throwable_snowflake.name: Snowflake

throwable_squeaky_duck.description: A duck throwing a duck. It probably isn't a family dispute.
throwable_squeaky_duck.name: Squeaky Duck

throwable_starlight_orb.description: Starlight packed into a little orb. Has anyone checked whether the sky is missing a star?
throwable_starlight_orb.name: Starlight Axolotl's Star Orb

throwable_tennis_ball.description: We picked someone to throw it. We're still looking for someone to fetch it.
throwable_tennis_ball.name: Tennis Ball

throwable_timber.description: A tree throws a tiny tree. Perhaps we should check the family tree first.
throwable_timber.name: Little Tree's Tiny Tree

throwable_tissue_ball.description: No one knows whether it's used toilet paper. Just dodge it!
throwable_tissue_ball.name: Tissue Ball

throwable_toy_cannon.description: A mini cannon throwable that fires a fuse-lit shell.
throwable_toy_cannon.name: Mini Cannon

throwable_wakkuball.description: Crunch! Enjoy the crisp sound as the Wakku Ball shatters into pieces.
throwable_wakkuball.name: Wakku Ball
